TOPMESSAGE---->START: Make sure to read the YAMAHA DIAGNOSTIC SYSTEM instruction manual and warnings \rand cautions in the service manual concerned before operating the diagnostic system.\rDo not conduct the diagnostic test without reviewing these manuals.
Make sure to read your PC user's manual before operating the  diagnostic system.\rMake sure that the PC and communication cable terminal are not splashed \rwith water during operation.

To set up the diagnostic system, take the following steps to prevent the PC \rfrom malfunctioning or being damaged.(Outboard Engine,WaterCraft)\rCheck that the battery is fully charged. (Outboard Engine,WaterCraft)\rCheck that the battery terminals are not corroded and that the battery cable is connected securely. (Outboard Engine,WaterCraft)\rCheck that the connections of the communication cable and electrical wiring are secure. (Outboard Engine,WaterCraft)\rCheck that the fuse is not burned out. (Outboard Engine,WaterCraft)\rSet the shift into the neutral position. (Outboard Engine)\rMake sure to moor the WaterCraft. (WaterCraft).\rConnect the communication cable to the PC and ECM. (Outboard Engine,WaterCraft)\rTurn the engine main switch to ON. (Outboard Engine)\rPush the start switch to start the engine. (WaterCraft)
